name: dualhabitat-matrix-desktop
description: DualHabitat Matrix 桌面端：总览服务、配模型、管人格、发消息、看日志
author: Delance

scripts.green: npm run prepare:vendor && npm run prepare:bridge && node scripts/build-green.mjs
scripts.installer: npm run prepare:vendor && npm run prepare:bridge && npm run patch:builder && npm run icon && node scripts/build-installer.mjs
scripts.installer:lite: npm run prepare:vendor && npm run prepare:bridge && npm run patch:builder && npm run icon && node scripts/build-installer.mjs --no-napcat
scripts.installer:full: npm run prepare:vendor && npm run prepare:bridge && npm run patch:builder && npm run icon && node scripts/build-installer.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run prepare:vendor && npm run prepare:bridge && npm run patch:builder && electron-builder --win --dir
